description: This file contains utility functions for detecting operating system environment details and path formats, such as whether the system is Windows, if a path is a Windows path, if a path is a WSL Windows path, and checking the WSL installation status. It includes functions like is_win(), is_win_path(), is_wsl_win_path(), wsl_prefix(), and check_wsl_install().

methods.name: bool is_win()
methods.description: Returns true if the operating system is Windows.

methods.name: bool is_win_path(path:str)
methods.description: Checks if the provided path follows Windows path conventions by splitting on backslash and verifying if the drive letter ends with ':'.

methods.name: bool is_wsl_win_path(path:str)
methods.description: Checks if the given path indicates a Windows path within WSL by checking a specific prefix.

methods.name: str wsl_prefix()
methods.description: Returns the appropriate WSL prefix command if on Windows, otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: None check_wsl_install()
methods.description: Attempts to verify if the Riallto WSL instance is installed by executing a command inside WSL and handling errors.
